Which Premier League players are set for yellow card suspensions?
- Published
The first one-match suspensions for yellow card offences in the 2026-27 Premier League season have now been served.
Hull City's Matt Crooks and Aston Villa's Matty Cash became the first players to receive a ban for accumulating five yellow cards before gameweek 19.
Players receive a one-match suspension if they pick up five or more yellow cards prior to the conclusion of their team's 19th league match of the season.
There are now 13 players sitting on four bookings after 10 rounds of matches, meaning they must avoid another yellow card prior to the halfway point of the season to avoid a ban.
Bournemouth have the most players on the brink of a ban, with three players one yellow card away from suspension.
After that date, the threshold increases to 10 yellow cards. Any player reaching that number before the end of their club's 32nd league match of the season will receive a two-match suspension.
From that point, there are further thresholds at 15 and 20 yellow cards.
For players reaching 15 cautions, they incur a three-match suspension. Punishments for players reaching 20 yellow cards are determined by a regulatory commission.
Those cut-offs do not reset until the end of the Premier League season.
In the Championship, League One and League Two, there are similar thresholds.
However, with those three divisions having 46 rounds of league matches instead of 38, players have to avoid getting 10 yellow cards before the end of the 37th league match in order to not receive a two-match suspension.
In those divisions, the yellow cards are reset at the end of the league season and do not include matches in the play-offs.

Which Premier League players have the most yellow cards?
The following players have served a one-match ban and will now receive a two-match ban if they reach ten bookings before game week 32:
- Matt Crooks - Hull City (five yellow cards)
- Matty Cash - Aston Villa (five)
If any of the following players receive another Premier League yellow card before the season's halfway point, they will be banned for one match:
- Vitaly Janelt - Brentford (four)
- Igor Thiago - Brentford (four)
- Oli McBurnie - Hull City (four)
- Harry Maguire - Manchester United (four)
- Pascal Gross - Brighton & Hove Albion (four)
- Ethan Ampadu - Leeds United (four)
- Oliver Boscagli - Brighton & Hove Albion (four)
- Adam Smith - Bournemouth (four)
- Marcus Tavernier - Bournemouth (four)
- Antonio Silve - Bournemouth (four)
- Yeremy Pino - Crystal Palace (four)
- Alexis Mac Allister - Liverpool (four)
- James McAtee - Nottingham Forest (four)
Which players are suspended for gameweek ten?
The following players will miss their club's next set of fixtures:
- Max Dowman - Arsenal (red card suspension)
- Jean-Philippe Mateta - Crystal Palace (red card suspension)
- Igor Thiago - Brentford (red card suspension)

digest_he:
עונת 2026-2027 בפרמייר ליג מביאה עמה את ההשעיות הראשונות עקב צבירת כרטיסים צהובים. מאט קרוקס מהאל סיטי ומאטי קאש מאסטון וילה הפכו לשחקנים הראשונים שריצו הרחקה של משחק אחד לאחר שצברו חמישה כרטיסים צהובים לפני המחזור ה-19.

נכון לעכשיו, 13 שחקנים נוספים מחזיקים בארבעה כרטיסים צהובים כל אחד, ועליהם להיזהר מצהוב נוסף טרם מחצית העונה כדי להימנע מהשעיה אוטומטית. בין השחקנים הבולטים הנמצאים בסכנה ניתן למצוא את הארי מגווייר ממנצ'סטר יונייטד, אלכסיס מק אליסטר מליברפול ושחקנים נוספים מקבוצות כמו ברנטפורד, בורנמות' וברייטון.

בהמשך העונה, הרף עולה ומחמיר בהדרגה. שחקנים שיגיעו לעשרה צהובים עד המחזור ה-32 יספגו הרחקה לשני משחקים, כאשר קיימים ספים נוספים של 15 ו-20 כרטיסים צהובים המובילים לענישה כבדה יותר. בנוסף, מספר שחקנים ובהם מק דאון מארסנל וז'אן-פיליפ מטטה מקריסטל פאלאס מושעים ממחזור המשחקים הקרוב בשל כרטיסים אדומים.
